prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters with simple rounded cartoon bodies, flat colour and black outlines, but every face is painted with startling real skin: pores, stubble, wrinkles, wet tired eyes, real eyelids, far more lifelike than anything around it, no feature exaggerated. Every colour is laid on in thick visible oil brushstrokes. Night, close in a freezing attic: a tiny white woman in her eighties with thin silver hair in a hairnet, a long pointed nose and a mole on one cheek, wrapped in three cardigans and a crocheted blanket, her real-skinned face large in frame, frost on her eyelashes and eyebrows, blue lips, breath steaming. In front of her on a saucer, the last of a candle: only a flat puddle of wax with a tiny drowning flame in the middle, guttering, about to go out. Icicles hang from the beam above. Most of the frame cold blue shadow; the brightest value is the tiny flame on her face. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
